eligibility_reason: The paper estimates the prevalence and concentration of AI-generated political images on X, not misinformation defined by falsity or low credibility. AI-generated content is an adjacent construct that may also include wholly true content.

considered_but_excluded.why: Prevalence of AI-generated images, an adjacent construct rather than misinformation prevalence.
Share of image-sharing users who shared AI-generated content; AI-generated content is an adjacent construct.
Share of image spreaders responsible for disseminating AI-generated images; adjacent construct.
Share of AI-generated images disseminated by the top approximately 10% of image spreaders; concentration of an adjacent construct.
Share of processed images receiving valid detector responses, not prevalence.
False-positive rate of the AI-image classifier, not prevalence.
False-negative rate of the AI-image classifier, not prevalence.
Share of AIGC superspreaders with X Premium subscriptions, a user characteristic.
Share of non-superspreaders with X Premium subscriptions, a user characteristic.
Political-affiliation composition within superspreaders, not misinformation prevalence.
Share of superspreaders without clear political affiliations, not misinformation prevalence.
Cited from another paper and explicitly not this paper's own result.
